snippet.title: DYNASTHIR  Official Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY NOVEMBER 14TH!!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145210/Dynasthir
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145210/Dynasthir
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145210/Dynasthir

In its dying breath, Dynasthir beckons. Bestowed upon you is a vast obscure world inviting methodical exploration, skillful combat & profound moments of awe. Push into the unknown & maybe you'll live to tell your tale.

The world is dying. Will you persist?

Created and Developed by 
Peter 'Mireneye' Elvin
Ulfgang Bristall

Credits and many thanks go to the illustrious:

Music by Riotbard
Website: https://www.snowdaymedia.net
Email: riotbard@snowdaymedia.net
Portofolio: https://vimeo.com/snowdaymedia

Voice Acting by Jullian Champenois
Website: https://www.jullianstudio.com
Email: contact@jullian.be



Thank you for your interest and we hope you look forward to playing Dynasthir on release!
https://bsky.app/profile/twinlakeminstrels.bsky.social
